title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch Solid Brass, 3-Tier Wall Mount | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling towels on the counter—store and dry them in one space-saving wall-mounted design in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. This traditional towel shelf with drying rack keeps folded towels organized while giving you an integrated rack for towels that need to air out.

  • Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Maintain a clean, refined look thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate your space with multiple designer finish options available for matching traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.
  • Long-term confidence with a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Specs & Installation
Material: Brass
Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
Dimensions (L × W × H): 24.7 in × 8.9 in × 10.4 in
Projection: 3.5 in
Weight: 5.6 lb
Assembly: Some assembly required
Included: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
